purpose: Minimal read-only diagnosis of whether Ubuntu APT exposes zbar-tools through the verifier discovery query surface.

steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
echo '=== ZBAR POLICY ==='
apt-cache policy zbar-tools || true
echo '=== ZBAR SHOW ==='
apt-cache show zbar-tools 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,80p' || true
echo '=== SEARCH BAR CODE ==='
apt-cache search 'bar code' | grep -i -E 'zbar|bar code|barcode' | tail -n 60 || true
echo '=== SEARCH DECODE ==='
apt-cache search decode | grep -i -E 'zbar|bar code|barcode' | tail -n 60 || true
